'Houseki no Kuni' Creator Launches New Manga
The December 2026 issue of Monthly Afternoon magazine announced on Friday that manga creator Haruko Ichikawa will launch a new sci-fi manga, titled Cosmic Mimimi, in the magazine next issue, scheduled for a November 25 release. Haruko is best known for Houseki no Kuni (Land of the Lustrous), which ran in Monthly Afternoon magazine from October 2012 to April 2024. The 13th and final volume went on sale on November 2024. 'Ousama no Propose' Reveals Lead Cast, 2027 Debut
The Fantasia Bunko Daikanshasai 2026 event revealed the lead cast and a teaser visual (pictured) for the television anime adaptation of Koushi Tachibana's Ousama no Propose (King’s Proposal) light novel on Sunday. The anime series will premiere in 2027. Rie Takahashi (Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!) is starring as the lead character Saika Kuozaki. 'Akane-banashi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Yuuki Suenaga and Takamasa Moue's Akane-banashi manga revealed a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the second season on Sunday. The anime series will begin airing on the IMAnimation programming block on TV Asahi's 24 affiliate stations, as well as BS Asahi and other stations in January 2027.
